title: "The Bond Films"

::: {#0c3e0fa6 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


::: {#2e0b9c2a .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```
:::


The dataset includes James Bond films from 1995 to 2021. @fig-bond shows their worldwide revenue over time.

::: {#cell-fig-bond .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
